subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should detailed, account-wide Cursor usage-event history be fetched only through a new explicit opt-in, or should enabling the existing cost summary authorize that authenticated dashboard request automatically?
rationale: The code expands an existing cookie-authenticated status integration into private, detailed usage-event collection and presents derived cost estimates; implementation correctness cannot determine the intended consent and privacy contract.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Add a dedicated disabled-by-default Cursor dashboard-cost consent setting with clear account-wide, private-endpoint, and estimate wording.

options.title: Reuse Cost Summary Consent
options.body: Treat the existing Show cost summary setting as sufficient authorization, but document the remote history collection and accept the broader privacy contract explicitly.

options.title: Keep Cursor Summary-Only
options.body: Do not merge the detailed history source and retain Cursor's existing status and quota behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated disabled-by-default Cursor dashboard-cost consent setting with clear account-wide, private-endpoint, and estimate wording.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository owner, authored the explicit hold, and have directly maintained this branch's auth and CLI/server behavior.
